ml:
effect Drafts
    save : (string, string) => Result<int, Error>
saveDraft path text = match perform Drafts.save path text
    Success _ => "Saved"
    Error message => "Retry: ${message}"
onSave () = saveDraft "draft.txt" "Ship it."

disk = handler Drafts
    save path text => writeFile path text

print (disk onSave)
